label: Owner framework commitment: At the selected world w, every candidate individual…, by Composition
meaning: For a bearer of causal power, or a cause, at w: it is in act in some respect (q.25 a.1, q.75 a.2); whatever is in act in some respect is in act in the respect of being (q.4 a.1 ad 3); being in act in the respect of being is having esse in re, which is the adopted definition of concrete (DEF-CONCRETE-ESSE-IN-RE).
